headline_marked: [[Teesta Master Plan work to begin next year]] says Relief Minister
headline: Teesta Master Plan work to begin next year says Relief Minister
summary: The government is preparing to start implementation of the comprehensive plan for the Teesta river basin to manage water and erosion erosion.
details: Relief and Rehabilitation Minister Mohammadi Saleh says the work on the Teesta Master Plan will begin next year.
The plan aims to provide a comprehensive solution to the river's water management and the recurring issues of erosion.
The minister noted that the government is committed to ensuring sustainable water flow and protecting the riverbanks from erosion.
This project is expected to benefit millions of people living along the Teesta river basin, particularly in the northern districts of Bangladesh.
caption:
Work on the Teesta Master Plan will start next year, according to the Relief Minister.

Relief and Rehabilitation Minister Mohammadi Saleh says the work on the Teesta Master Plan will begin next year.

The plan aims to provide a comprehensive solution to the river's water management and the recurring issues of erosion.

The minister noted that the government is committed to ensuring sustainable water flow and protecting the riverbanks from erosion.

This project is expected to benefit millions of people living along the Teesta river basin, particularly in the northern districts of Bangladesh.

headline: Myanmar to take back 300,000 Rohingya refugees if security improves
summary: The Myanmar government has announced its willingness to repatriate refugees if the security situation in Rakhine State improves.
details: The Myanmar government has stated that it is prepared to accept the return of 300,000 Rohingya refugees currently residing in Bangladesh.
caption:
Myanmar is open to repatriating 300,000 Rohingya refugees, but there is a catch: the security situation in Rakhine State must first improve.

The Myanmar government has stated that it is prepared to accept the return of 300,000 Rohingya refugees currently residing in Bangladesh.
